channel.title: The Christian Post - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Christian Post (christianpost.com)

item.title: Mayor defends decision to drop prayer invite for priest after church hosted drag event
item.description: A North Texas mayor is defending a decision to rescind an Episcopalian priest's invitation to open a city meeting with prayer after learning the pastor’s church hosted a drag show event with children in attendance. #Texas #CityCouncilPrayer #DragShow

item.title: Judge files lawsuit seeking to overturn Supreme Court's gay marriage ruling
item.description: A Texas judge who refused to marry same-sex couples because of her faith has filed a federal lawsuit seeking to overturn the 2015 U.S. Supreme Court decision that recognized same-sex marriage nationwide. #Texas #LGBT #SupremeCourt #Marriage

item.title: America's most sinful cities: What you need to know
item.description: Which American cities are the most "sinful?" The Christian Post's Ian Giatti joins Billy Hallowell to break down the top three most sinful cities listed in a recent WalletHub study. He explains what that means and why it matters. #Sin #America #LasVegas

item.title: Muslims block Christians from celebrating Christmas in Indonesia as police look on
item.description: As police looked on, Muslims in Indonesia formed a human wall to block Christians from attending a Christmas service, according to local media. #Islam #Christmas #Indonesia #Christianpersecution

item.title: Anet Jackson, co-founder of Faith Comes By Hearing, dies at 90
item.description: Anet Jackson, co-founder of the prominent audio Bible ministry group Faith Comes By Hearing, has died at the age of 90. #AnetJackson #FaithComesByHearing #evangelism #ministry #NewMexico #audio #Bible #missionary

item.title: Tucker Carlson crowned 2025 'Antisemite of the Year' by watchdog group
item.description: A watchdog group declared that media personality Tucker Carlson is the 2025 "Antisemite of the Year," highlighting the political commentator’s false statements about Israel and platforming of individuals who are infamous for spreading Jew hatred. #StopAntisemitism #TuckerCarlson #Antisemiteoftheyear #antisemitismawareness

item.title: Maine church sues UMC, claims denomination is wrongfully trying to take over property
item.description: A small Maine congregation is suing a regional body of The United Methodist Church, claiming that the mainline denomination is trying to take over its property. #UnitedMethodistChurch #BroadCoveChurch #Maine #nondenominational #lawsuit #church

item.title: FBI arrests 'Darkwitch' planning New Year's Eve attack in New Orleans
item.description: A fifth suspect in a far-left terrorist group’s New Year’s Eve bombing plot, a former member of the U.S. Marines trained in combat who uses the aliases “Darkwitch She/Her" and "Kateri The Witch," was arrested on his way to New Orleans with guns, a gas canister and body armor in the car, according to court documents. #FBI #NewYearsEvebombing #NewOrleans #domesticterrorism #darkwitch

item.title: 'An early Christmas gift': 130 abducted Catholic school students, staff freed in Nigeria
item.description: Nigerian officials announced Monday that the remaining 130 students and staff abducted from a Catholic school in the country's north have been freed, ending a harrowing month-long captivity and allowing families to reunite just in time for Christmas. #Nigeria #kidnappings #Christianpersecution

item.title: Ben Sasse reveals terminal cancer, points to faith in Christ: 'A real Deliverer'
item.description: Former Sen. Ben Sasse, R-Neb., revealed Tuesday that he has Stage 4 pancreatic cancer and expects to die soon, but expressed hope in Jesus Christ and Heaven amid his suffering. #BenSasse #Nebraska #politics
